Key Selling Points

What to Lead With in Every Conversation

These are your strongest angles for lifestyle business owners. Use these to open, pivot, or close.

💳

Dual Pricing / Cash Discount

Say This

"If you're doing $30K+ a month, we can set up a cash discount program that essentially eliminates your processing fees. Most of your competitors are still eating those costs."

  • Only available for businesses doing $30K+/mo in revenue
  • Customers see a small discount for paying cash — fully compliant
  • This is a huge margin saver for salons and spas with high ticket averages
🖥️

All-In-One EkiKart Software

Say This

"Right now you're probably paying for a POS, a separate booking system, maybe a loyalty app — we replace all of that with one platform. One login, one bill, one support number."

  • Appointments, memberships, payments, inventory, loyalty — all built in
  • Cloud-based — they can check reports from their phone
  • No more juggling 3-4 different software subscriptions
📱

Flexible Hardware Options

Say This

"We don't force you into one setup. Need something portable for a trainer on the floor? We've got that. Need a full front-desk station? We've got that too. We match the hardware to how you actually work."

  • Three tiers: handheld, full station, or premium station
  • All hardware is cloud-connected and runs EkiKart
  • Easy to scale — start with one and add more as they grow
🔄

Memberships & Recurring Billing

Say This

"Most POS systems treat memberships as an afterthought. Ours is built for it — auto-billing, package tracking, class passes, the whole thing. Your front desk staff won't need a separate system."

  • Auto-recurring billing for memberships and packages
  • Track class passes, session credits, and expiration dates
  • Big differentiator for fitness studios and wellness businesses
📊

Cloud Reporting & Insights

Say This

"You can see your daily sales, your busiest hours, which stylist or trainer is bringing in the most revenue — all from your phone. No more waiting until end-of-day to know how you're doing."

  • Real-time dashboards accessible from any device
  • Track staff performance, product sales, retention
  • Owners love this — especially multi-location operators
🛡️

Secure & Compliant Processing

Say This

"We handle PCI compliance, encryption, tokenization — all the security stuff your merchant doesn't want to think about. Tap, chip, swipe, mobile wallet — it all just works."

  • Contactless, chip, swipe, and mobile wallet support
  • PCI-DSS compliant out of the box
  • Fraud protection and chargeback management included
Know Your Prospect

Pain Points & Solutions by Vertical

Different businesses have different headaches. Here's what to listen for and how to position RevitPay.

🏋️

Fitness Studios

Common Pain Points
  • Membership billing is manual or uses a separate app
  • Class scheduling is disconnected from payments
  • No-shows and late cancellations hurt revenue
  • Can't track trainer performance easily
  • No way to sell retail (supplements, gear) at checkout
How We Solve It
  • Built-in membership & recurring billing
  • Class scheduling tied directly to POS
  • Automated reminders reduce no-shows
  • Staff performance reporting
  • Integrated retail & inventory tracking
  • Mobile check-ins via handheld terminal
✂️

Salons

Common Pain Points
  • High no-show rates losing $200-500/week
  • Stylists double-booked or underutilized
  • Tip management is messy and manual
  • Retail products sit unsold — no POS integration
  • Client preferences not tracked between visits
How We Solve It
  • SMS confirmations and automated reminders
  • Stylist scheduling with chair utilization tracking
  • Built-in tip management at checkout
  • Retail POS with product inventory
  • Customer notes & preference history
  • Appointment management with online booking
🧖

Spas

Common Pain Points
  • Treatment room scheduling conflicts
  • Gift cards tracked manually or on paper
  • Wellness packages hard to manage across visits
  • Client intake forms are still on clipboards
  • No follow-up system after treatments
How We Solve It
  • Treatment room scheduling built in
  • Digital gift card support & tracking
  • Spa package & wellness membership management
  • Digital client intake forms
  • Automated follow-ups and rebooking prompts
  • Integrated payments — no separate gateway needed

Objection Handling

When They Push Back, Say This

The most common objections you'll hear from lifestyle business owners and how to handle them.

"We already have a POS system."
"That's great — what are you paying for it, and does it handle your appointments and memberships too? Most owners are paying for a POS plus a booking system plus a loyalty app. We consolidate all of that into one. Can I show you how much you'd save?"
"I don't want to switch — it's too much hassle."
"Totally understand. We handle the setup and data migration for you. Most businesses are fully up and running in a day or two. And the time you save after switching pays for itself in the first month."
"How much does it cost?"
"It depends on the setup, but here's the thing — if you're doing $30K+ a month, our dual pricing program can offset your entire processing cost. So instead of paying fees, you're actually keeping more of what you make. Let me run your numbers."
"We're too small for all this."
"That's actually exactly when you want to get the right system — before you outgrow a basic setup. Our Good bundle is just a handheld terminal. It's simple, portable, and you can scale up whenever you're ready. No big commitment."
"I just use Square / Clover / Toast."
"Those are fine for general retail, but they weren't built for your business. They don't do membership billing, class scheduling, or treatment room management out of the box. You end up bolting on extra apps. We built this specifically for fitness, salons, and spas."
"What if I need help after setup?"
"RevitPay has live support — real humans, not a chatbot. You call, someone picks up. That's one of the biggest things our merchants say they love about us versus the big-box processors."
Qualifying the Prospect

Questions to Ask Early in the Call

These help you figure out which bundle to pitch and whether dual pricing is on the table.

1

Monthly Revenue

"Roughly what are you doing in monthly revenue?" — If $30K+, lead with dual pricing. That's your strongest hook.

2

Current Setup

"What are you using for payments and scheduling right now?" — Find out if they're paying for multiple tools. That's your consolidation angle.

3

Business Type & Size

"How many locations? Staff? Chairs/rooms/trainers?" — This tells you which bundle and whether multi-location management matters.

4

Pain Point

"What's the one thing about your current system that drives you crazy?" — Let them tell you the problem. Then match it to our solution.

5

Retail Sales

"Do you sell any products — shampoo, supplements, gear?" — If yes, pitch the inventory tracking. Most lifestyle businesses leave money on the table here.

6

Decision Timeline

"When are you looking to make a change?" — Gauge urgency. If their current contract is ending soon, push for a demo now.
